note: Fresh code audit of the uncommitted working tree on 24 Oct, replacing the pre-implementation audit (kept at superseded/audit-P5-pre.json). All P5 code (apps/api/src/{agile,time-tracking,kb,service-management,report,pages,customer-invitation}, migrations 0148-0154, 33 tests/api-integration/p5-*.test.ts, web components) is untracked/uncommitted and every P5 feature flag is default-off. implemented_tested = behaviour present in code AND a test asserts it; it does NOT mean an executed integration run: this audit ran no database, so the 33 P5 integration suites are cited as present, not run (no P5 integration run result was found in docs/report). Unit runs executed by this audit, 24 Oct 16:59, all green: U1 = API unit tests/api/{agile,kb,report,time-tracking} 5 files 110/110; U2 = web P5 components (agile, time-tracking, reports, kb, service-management, workflow/cab-template-panel) plus lib/report-search and lib/dashboard-layout, 31 files 158/158; U3 = packages/domain service-management 2 files 29/29. browser_verified is false for every item: scripted sign-in is blocked and no P5 screen was exercised in a browser. Not counted here: the requirements index assigns no CP, IP, VW or PG row to P5, and build-data counts only the 91 P5 ids. Unindexed ids (no row in docs/requirements-index.json in any phase, so they cannot be counted anywhere until rows are added): Pages PG-1..PG-8 (feature-contracts-p5.md) and the invitation ids CP-20..CP-29 and IP-35. Of these, PG-7 undelete is API-only (POST /projects/{projectId}/pages/{id}/undelete has no web caller), and CP-22/CP-26 limits are hard-coded in apps/api/src/customer-invitation/logic.ts CUSTOMER_INVITATION_LIMITS rather than instance configuration; lane claims about CP-24 and CP-27..29 were not re-verified. Indexed elsewhere and not re-verified here: CP-12, CP-17, CP-18, IP-9, IP-29 (P3) and VW-20 (P1).

top_gaps: Evidence: nothing in P5 is browser-verified (scripted sign-in blocked) and none of the 33 P5 integration suites was run by this audit; 62 implemented_tested items rest on unrun integration tests plus green unit runs. All P5 code is uncommitted.

Cost tracking: no cost types or cost entries (TC-12, TC-13, TC-14 missing), so budget actuals are time-only (TC-16), committed is always null (TC-17) and 75/90% thresholds raise no notification (TC-18).
Capacity: no available_hours (TC-20 missing); utilisation and the capacity report use team capacity_days_per_week instead (TC-21, TC-22).

Reports: metric_snapshot and the metrics-snapshot job exist at day grain for SLA attainment, SLA trend and throughput only (RP-9, partial); large exports are queued and downloaded from an authenticated route but people/leadership/customers reports still cap their own rows and there is no emailed link (RP-10, partial); every tier 1 report, tier 3 report and widget now drills (RP-12). None of it is browser-verified.

Knowledge base authoring: callouts and work item references cannot be inserted in the editor (KB-5, KB-6); owner not settable in the editor (KB-7); matching is a LIKE scan, not a full-text index (KB-9); related and most-viewed/recent ordering untested (KB-15, KB-16).
Change and release: CAB gating is an opt-in template, not the default (CH-2); low-risk pre-approval edge is not generated (CH-3); releases flagged for the portal have no portal surface (REL-5).
Velocity counts only cycles closed with the completion action; cycles that end by date have no snapshot and no daily snapshot job exists (CY-9).

Unindexed requirements: PG-1..8, CP-20..29 and IP-35 have contract ids but no row in docs/requirements-index.json, so no phase counts them; PG-7 undelete has no UI and CP-22/CP-26 invitation limits are hard-coded rather than instance configuration.

Browser-verify P5 screens on persisted data once scripted sign-in is unblocked: cycles (drag from backlog, completion dialog), modules, estimates preview, timesheet/timer reload, budget, rates, reports and dashboards (drag/resize), KB editor and portal deflection, services, changes, freeze override, calendar, releases.
Build cost types and cost entries (TC-12..14) and then committed (TC-17) and the 75/90% notification (TC-18), or record an owner deferral.
Decide available_hours (TC-20..22): build per-person capacity or record team capacity as the accepted substitute.

Reports: decide whether day-grain snapshots of three metrics satisfy RP-9 or the hourly grain and more metrics are wanted; let the people, leadership and customers reports read the export row cap, and decide on the emailed download link (RP-10); browser-verify the export status panel, drill dialogs and the snapshot boundary line.

KB: add callout and work-item-reference insertion and an owner picker to the editor using Kaneo/packages/ui Tiptap pieces (KB-5..7); add tests for related selection and popular/recent ordering (KB-15, KB-16).

Service management: add a portal release-notes surface (REL-5); decide whether CAB becomes default and how the low-risk pre-approval edge is authored (CH-2, CH-3); snapshot cycles that end by date for velocity (CY-9).

currentAssessment.method: Provisional source-only per-ID assessment of enforcing paths and available test-assertion locators, with historical state/evidence/gap retained. An assertion label may be a suite heading; such rows say so. Historical test locators not independently traced are labelled in row gaps. This auditor executed no tests, browser journeys, migrations or database operations and gives no phase sign-off.

localFindings.summary: Budget committedMinor remains null because point estimates do not encode remaining time; planned-versus-actual-versus-committed is not fulfilled without a conversion contract or explicit owner exception.
Snapshot job stores day grain and only selected metrics while the retained contract calls for hourly closed-period snapshots.
People, leadership and customer report queries hard-cap rows at 200/500 before CSV export, so large export cannot preserve full filtered populations.
CAB workflow is opt-in for a fresh workspace and its template lacks the low-risk preapproval edge; freeze and rollback gates therefore depend on an applied template.
A release may be marked for portal publication, but no customer-safe portal list/detail route or page exposes it.
Knowledge-base search uses lower-cased LIKE over title/body rather than the retained full-text index; title weighting exists but index/search semantics do not.
